# Training week 2025-05

## Decisions

- Strength training twice a week keeps the injuries away.
- Easy runs should feel easy, I keep running them too fast.
- Stretching after every run, ten minutes, no excuses.
- Physio exercises: clamshells, bridges, calf raises.
- New shoes after 700 kilometres, the old ones are flat.
- Resting heart rate is down to 5 after three months.

## Open questions

Protein with every meal, more vegetables at dinner. Carla joins the Thursday run, slower pace that day. Weekly distance goes up by at most ten percent. Intervals on Wednesday: six times 800 metres with two minutes rest. Knee felt sore after the hill session, skip hills this week. Long run on Sunday, easy pace, around 15 kilometres.

## Notes

Rest day means really resting, a walk is fine. Drink before the long run, take a gel after one hour. Race goal is to finish under two hours, without walking.
